name: Crow
description: Blackwing decks used Black Whirlwind to turn a Normal Summon into another monster in hand. Icarus Attack gave their Winged Beasts a second use by trading one for two opposing cards.

defining_cards.name: Blackwing - Shura the Blue Flame
defining_cards.why: Winning a battle let Shura fetch another Blackwing from the Deck, often a Tuner for a second Main Phase Synchro Summon.

defining_cards.name: Icarus Attack
defining_cards.why: Tributing a Winged Beast could destroy two opposing cards, giving Blackwings a way to interrupt plays on either player's turn.

defining_cards.name: Black Whirlwind
defining_cards.why: A Blackwing Normal Summon could search a smaller Blackwing, often finding a Tuner or a combat trick.

defining_cards.name: Blackwing - Kalut the Moon Shadow
defining_cards.why: Its 1,400 ATK boost from the hand made seemingly safe attacks against Blackwings risky.

defining_cards.name: Blackwing - Gale the Whirlwind
defining_cards.why: It could join another Blackwing without using the Normal Summon, halve an opposing monster's stats and serve as a Tuner.
